name: Observation Deck in an Abandoned Ferris Wheel
description: One cabin of an abandoned ferris wheel becomes a stargazing observation deck, with glass walls, cozy lights, and a star-filled sky.
prompt: A single cinematic image of one abandoned ferris wheel cabin converted into a stargazing observation deck. Glass walls, cozy warm lights, small telescope, wooden floor, star-filled night sky, quiet abandoned amusement park, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark.
caption: Even abandoned places can point you toward the stars.
